    results = frappe.get_all("Shift Type", fields=["name", "start_time"])
    for s in results:
        start = frappe.utils.get_time(s['start_time'])
        if time_in.hour == start.hour or start.hour >= 19:
            shift = s['name']
        
    if not shift:
        frappe.throw("Aucun shift correspondant trouvé.")

    attendance = frappe.new_doc('Attendance')
    attendance.employee = employee
    attendance.attendance_date = date_in
    attendance.check_in = time_in.time()
    attendance.check_out = time_out.time()
    #attendance.hours_worked = hours_worked

    if type_emploie == 'Nationaux':
        attendance.status = "Present"
        attendance.shift = shift
    else:
        attendance.status = "On Leave"
        attendance.leave_type = 'P'
        attendance.shift = 'P'

    attendance.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    attendance.submit()
    frappe.log(f"Attendance créé pour {employee} ({shift})")
